title: Autonomous Floating Sword
paragraphs: “Now that I think about it…”
Then, Itsuki changed the shape of his weapon to something resembling a flamethrower and showed us a fuel tank-like object strapped to his back.
“What’s that?”
“It’s a variant weapon classified as a magical flamethrower. Apparently, if you insert a weapon imbued with magic into this tank, it allows you to fire projectiles.”
“Okay. And what’s the plan? Are you going to take magic power from a staff or something and fire it?”
“That’s right… but it seems to have a skill called automatic magic supply, similar to Naofumi’s automatic sharpening. Originally, it’s supposed to restore the stolen magic power…”
Father clapped his hands together.
“If we use it correctly, we might be able to restore the lost magic power in the staves!”
“Exactly. Please insert one and try it out.”

Following Itsuki’s instructions, we took a powerful staff lying around—called the Magic Staff Apocalypse—and inserted it into the tank on his back. With a bubbling sound, the staff floated inside the tank, dyeing the liquid within a purple hue.
“…Initial ammo count is zero. Ah, but the ammo is slowly recovering.”
“Once it’s full, we should take it out and check, right?”
“Yes.”
“This should significantly boost our combat strength… but should we wait until the sharpening and recharging are done?”
“I’ve done the minimum necessary enhancements, so we won’t fall behind. Let’s continue exploring.”
Father and Itsuki both suggested continuing, and Ren and I nodded in agreement.
“Maybe we should let Rat use a whip? Does a whip fall under the sharpening category or the magic category?”
“Well… either way is fine.”
“Ah, I found a slot where the whip can go.”
Father smoothly inserted the whip into the highest-grade sharpening shield. The doctor looked at Father with a tired expression. It’s an incredible weapon far beyond what he deserves.
“Rifana, maybe claws for you?”
“Anything is fine!”
“A dagger or something that takes advantage of your speed would be good. Just wait a bit.”
“Okay!”
“Oh my…”
“Sadeena, you should take a spear like Motoyasu.”
“Got it. But… this looks heavy to swing around.”
“You’ll be fine. You’ve raised your level enough, and your aptitude has improved too, hasn’t it?”
“Yeah, that’s true.”
With that, we set off toward the next treasure vault. On the way, we tested some of the new skills we had acquired. Ren was the first to unleash his skill at a newly appearing named demon.
“Fragarach X!”
A floating sword appeared in front of Ren and flew toward the enemy. It looked like it was slashing at the target on its own.
“A floating sword?”
“I’m not a fan of float-type swords…”
However, the sword that attacked on its own kept relentlessly attacking the demon.
“In the first world, Ren would just stand there like a statue when he used the floating sword skill.”
“Really? So, does that mean the current Ren is stronger?”
“Not exactly… It’s just that the sword appears and fights on its own…”
Ren answered while pointing at the sword that was automatically slicing through the demon, looking a little dumbfounded.
“Ah… I see. It’s Fragarach, after all.”
Father nodded in understanding. Soon after, Itsuki followed Ren and unleashed his skill.
“Tathlum X!”
With a loud bang, a massive stone-like magical projectile flew toward the demon. Whoa… it blew a hole in the wall.
“I’ll do it too! Brio—”
“Use the new skill!”
Oops, I almost used it out of habit. Brionac is really handy.
“Endless Lancer X!”

I tried out the new skill. Oh? The spear spun as it thrust forward, drilling into the enemy. The demons ahead of me were minced… and completely disintegrated. That’s amazing. Although it seems a bit difficult to handle due to its lengthy preparation. It’s less versatile than Brionac. But… if used correctly, it could be a powerful offensive tool.
“I still don’t know what Father’s Defense Link skill does.”
“Judging by the name, I can only assume it’s something like sharing defense stats or something similar.”
“In the game… wasn’t that considered a useless skill?”
“Yeah.”

There’s no reason to take hits needlessly. Since none of us wanted to get hurt, we moved to a safer area where Big Sister and the others tested it in a mock battle. As expected, Defense Link was a skill where Father absorbed the damage taken by others. The damage taken was mitigated by Father’s defense stats. In effect, it was as if we all shared Father’s defense. This is an incredibly useful skill. Well, not that I have any intention of letting him take damage unnecessarily. I can’t let Father get hurt.
“But… Ren and Itsuki’s new skills, and the fact that Motoyasu mistakenly tried to use Brionac… Why do Lugh’s weapons always seem to have something in common…?”
“Lugh?”
Ren tilted his head.
“Don’t you know?”
“It’s a god from Celtic mythology. You didn’t know, Ren?”
“It’s not surprising if the name of the weapon gained fame on its own.”
“Reading fantasy stories can be fun.”
“I like that sort of thing, but…”
“Even within Japan, the level of awareness can vary, I suppose.”
“I can’t deny that, but we also need to consider Ren’s level of understanding.”
As always, Itsuki’s accuracy was in full effect. Ren furrowed his brows for a moment but quickly brushed it off, probably used to it by now.
“So, is Fragarach the weapon of this god named Lugh?”
“Yeah. To put it simply, it’s a weapon that automatically slashes at enemies and inflicts wounds that can’t be healed.”
“That’s why it’s a floating sword, huh?”
“Mythical weapons tend to have some pretty nasty effects. Like inflicting unhealable wounds…”
“If it accidentally hit an ally, that would be a disaster. Anyway, maybe the weapons we found in that treasure vault earlier were Celtic-themed. Where did you get your Brionac, Motoyasu?”
“My big sister’s sister salvaged a spear from the sea, which I copied. That copy eventually grew into this weapon.”
It looked like a coral spear. That eventually evolved into Brionac.

The Filolials all spoke up together. As expected of the Filolials. Come to think of it, they had all been fascinated by the carriage earlier. While we continued chatting and exploring, a ding sound, like that of toast popping out of a toaster, echoed from Father’s direction.
“Looks like the sharpening is complete. Oh, and the magic effects have been restored too, so it would be great if everyone could use them now.”
“Oh my, that’s quite an impressive weapon.”
Big Sister’s sister swung the magic spear Rune as she spoke.
“It looks like the claws aren’t part of the Celtic theme. Rifana, everyone, go ahead and take them.”
“Okay!”
Strengthening our gear step by step like this is one of the joys of a game. Now we’re practically invincible. Big Sister also received the staff that had been replenished with magic power by Itsuki.
“The magic power… is incredible. I’m not sure I can handle it.”
“The required stats are probably pretty high. Please be careful when using it.”
By the way, Big Sister’s friend received several daggers along with the claws. Sakura, being a dual wielder, accepted a pair of swords. Rival also received a weapon from Father.
